First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}
Status: Unknown (missing)
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light}

Description

A large, imposing churchman of the Light who holds the title of Primus, headmaster of the Light's academies for both clerics and paladins.
He recruited a young @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} into the order and steered him toward the paladins rather than the clergy.

Role

He believed in Roderic when others did not.
After the disaster of the lost battalion — when Roderic woke the sole survivor among mutilated dead and was suspected of submitting to the darkness — Griswald arranged for him to become a knight-errant rather than face the judgment of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}.
He has now gone missing along with other faithful, vanished without a trace of struggle, and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.zd5gky5RlQyNjHGn]{Inquisitor Voss} used his name to lure Roderic to a clandestine meeting beneath the city.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Sir Roderic Lightbearer} — His protégé, whom he recruited as a boy and spared from disgrace
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light} — Head of its academies

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Revealed as Roderic's mentor and patron; his name was used to lure Roderic into the imperial tunnels, where Voss confessed that Griswald had vanished along with other faithful

Session Appearances

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Absent; named and discussed but not present
